subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: May WebChat hide the “New messages” catch-up indicator, and if so which persistent recovery affordance must remain for readers who are away from the live tail?
rationale: The existing auto-scroll setting intentionally leaves this control in place, so selecting hide, non-intrusive presentation, or an alternative control changes the product’s navigation and accessibility contract rather than repairing a defined regression.

options.title: Keep the catch-up control and refine it
options.body: Retain the manual return-to-latest action but make its presentation smaller, dismissible, or less obstructive.

options.title: Add an indicator visibility preference
options.body: Allow hiding the indicator only if another discoverable keyboard, button, or accessible return-to-latest action remains available.

options.title: Treat auto-scroll modes as sufficient
options.body: Close the request without another preference because the existing Always, Near bottom, and Off modes cover the intended reading workflows.

recommendation.title: Keep the catch-up control and refine it
recommendation.body: Retain the manual return-to-latest action but make its presentation smaller, dismissible, or less obstructive.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and prior issue assessment both place this product boundary in the current WebChat scroll/settings area.
